ERUDITE:
I As applied to men: पण्डितः (ता,
 तं): v. Learned.
II As applied to any
science, etc.: v. Abstruse, profound.

ERUPTION:
I A bursting forth:
(1) निःसरणम्;
(2) निर्गमः।
II Of the skin: what are these e.s:
*किं निर्गतमङ्गे: v. Pimple, itch.

ERUPTIVE: expr. by verb: निर्गच्छति (गम्, c.
1.)
or
निःसरति (सृ, c. 1.).
